probe: WebSocket handshakes against wss://rpc.tiramisu.db-chain.testnet.arkiv.network from one IP after a busy hour (several sessions and test runs)
method: curl --http1.1 with Connection: Upgrade / Upgrade: websocket / Sec-WebSocket-Version: 13, repeated; then the same with an x-api-key header
client_view: in Node and browsers the failed handshake surfaces as a bare ErrorEvent with no message and close code 1006, so the 429 is invisible to the application
